description.value: You release a swarm of combat drones from a deployment case. For the duration, at the start of each of your turns, you designate a creature within 60 feet of the swarm; the swarm harries it with 4d6 kinetic damage, no saving throw or attack roll required as the drones simply overwhelm the target's defenses.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Tech Powers, Level 6
